test_CyclicPoissonSampling: test CyclicPoissonSampling with sampling_prob, iterations, cycle_length, and partition_type to generate cyclic batches
test_BallsInBinsSampling: test BallsInBinsSampling with iterations and cycle_length to assign examples uniformly across bins
test_BMinSepSampling: test BMinSepSampling with sampling_prob, iterations, min_sep, and warm_start to enforce minimum separation between sampled examples
test_FixedBatchSampling: test FixedBatchSampling with batch_size, iterations, and replace to generate fixed-size random batches
test_UserSelectionStrategy: test UserSelectionStrategy wrapping a base strategy with examples_per_user_per_batch and shuffle_per_user for per-user batch selection
